defs.def: an award that is given to a person who wins a competition, race, etc. or who does very good work 奖；奖赏；奖励；奖品；奖金

ex.s: Tom has been awarded several prizes, but this teenage innovator remains humble.
ex.t: Tom已经获得了几个奖项，但这位年轻的创新者仍然谦虚。

ex.s: 3 Grand Prizes：Trip to Washington, D.C. for each of three winners, a parent and one other person of the winner’s choice.
ex.t: 3个大奖：三位获奖者各得一次华盛顿特区之旅，可带一名家长及获奖者选择的另一人。

ex.s: 6 First Prizes：The book Sky Pioneer：A Photobiography of Amelia Earhart signed by author Corinne Szabo and pilot Linda Finch.
ex.t: 6个一等奖：由作者科琳·萨博和飞行员琳达·芬奇签名的《天空先驱：阿梅莉亚·埃尔哈特摄影传记》一书。

ex.s: Among the writers of the plays in this collection, Paul Green, Susan Glaspell, Maxwell Anderson, Thornton Wilder, William Saroyan, and Tennessee Williams have all received Pulitzer Prizes for their contributions to the theater.
ex.t: 在本剧本集的作家中，保罗·格林、苏珊·格拉斯佩尔、麦克斯韦尔·安德森、桑顿·怀尔德、威廉·萨罗扬和田纳西·威廉姆斯都因其对戏剧的贡献而获得普利策奖。

ex.s: A British woman who won a S1 million prize after she was named the World's Best Teacher will use the cash to bring inspirational figures into UK schools.
ex.t: 一名英国女性在被评上世界最佳教师后赢得了100万美元奖金，她将用这笔钱把励志人物带进英国学校。

ex.s: Wang’s winning of the prize means that Chinese architects are ___________.
ex.t: 王澍获奖意味着中国建筑师____。

ex.s: Marie Curie(1869-1934) was a world-famous_________and was first awarded the Nobel Prize in 1903 for her extraordinary work in radioactivity.
ex.t: 玛丽\u00b7居里（1869-1934）是世界著名的_________，1903年因她在放射性方面的杰出工作首次被授予诺贝尔奖。

ex.s: It is no wonder that many, if not most, of China’s leading scholars and scientists emerged at Lianda, including the two Nobel Prize-winning physicists, Yang Zhenning and Li Zhengdao.
ex.t: 难怪中国许多——如果不是大多数——顶尖学者和科学家都出自联大，包括两位诺贝尔物理学奖得主杨振宁和李政道。

ex.s: Through such a balance, he had created a new type of Chinese architecture, said Tadao Ando, the winner of the 1995 Pritzker Prize.
ex.t: 1995年普利兹克奖得主安藤忠雄说，通过这种平衡，他创造了一种新型的中国建筑。

ex.s: How many people can each grand prize winner take on the free trip? （    ）
ex.t: 每位大奖获得者可以带多少人参加免费旅行？（    ）

ex.s: Wang Shu, a 49-year-old Chinese architect, won the 2012 Pritzker Architecture Prize — which is often referred to as the Nobel Prize in architecture — on February 28.
ex.t: 王澑，一位49岁的中国建筑师，获得了2012年普利兹克建筑奖——该奖常被称为建筑界的诺贝尔奖——于2月28日颁奖。

ex.s: Every year, ______ makes the most beautiful kite will win a prize in the Kite Festival.
ex.t: 每年，在风筝节上______做出最漂亮风筝的人将获奖。

ex.s: She was also regarded as a brilliant__________, and was again awarded the Nobel Prize in 1911 for the isolation of pure radium.
ex.t: 她也被认为是一位杰出的__________，并在1911年因分离出纯镭而再次获得诺贝尔奖。

ex.s: His novel The Old Man and the Sea, about the three-day epic struggle between an elderly fisherman and the biggest fish he had ever caught, won the Pulitzer Prize for Fiction in 1953.
ex.t: 他的小说《老人与海》讲述了一位老渔夫与他捕到的最大的鱼之间为期三天的史诗般的搏斗，于1953年获得普利策小说奖。

ex.s: Have you ever won any prizes before?

defs.def: something very important or valuable that is difficult to achieve or obtain 难能可贵的事物；难以争取的重要事物
good enough to win a prize in a competition 尤指动物、花或蔬菜

ex.s: What will Zafirakou do with her prize money?

defs.def: being a very good example of its kind 优秀的；典范性的；出类拔萃的
to value sth highly 珍视；高度重视

ex.s: Our formative environment as a species was information-poor, so our brains developed a mechanism that prized new information.
ex.t: 作为人类，我们形成期的环境是信息匮乏的，因此我们的大脑形成了一种重视新信息的机制。
